subject: Re: Kickoff - staffing, CPU not GPU, and one schema deadline
body:
Dmitri,

Staffing:
- Kaia Wolde 50%, canonicalization library.
- Rafael Duran 40%, the enumeration port and the n=8..10 verification.
- Vera Egede 30%, build system - nauty, gtest and GNU parallel all have to work in our CI, which is not free.
- Efe Lindqvist 25%, lineage-graph benchmark.

No GPU ask at all, which will make a change for you. This is CPU and memory: the n=10 run needs roughly 900 core-hours and about 60GB peak, and we'll shard it with parallel like the original does.

Deadline that does bind us: writing canonical forms alongside the lineage records means a new column. Corpus v2 migration freeze is 2026-07-10 per Jun's platform note, so the canonical-form column has to be written into the graph tables before 2026-07-10; after that date the schema is closed until the migration completes. That pulls Kaia's library milestone forward, not the Jul 17 recommendation.

Bruno
